new_theme: Parameter-tune L1 (dev): a Gaussian noise limiter (amplifier saturation model). Start graph at 48 kHz: Noise Source (float, Gaussian, amp 0.5) -> Throttle -> Rail (+-1.5) -> File Sink limited.dat. The limiter's input is tapped to File Sink noise_in.dat. Target: noise standard deviation 0.4 (measured within 2 %), and symmetric clip levels at the 2.5 % / 97.5 % quantiles of Gaussian noise with standard deviation exactly 0.4 (5 % clipped), each within 1 %. Values only: no blocks added, removed or rewired, no variables added, removed or renamed. The model must derive 1.96 x 0.4 = 0.784. v2 signature noise|nonlinear -> dev, cluster_id chain:noise|nonlinear. No other item holds the cell. Distinct from gbf-dev-02 (build, complex-noise envelope) and gbf-test-03 (build, band-limited noise).
deviation_from_plan: (1) Oracle: the plan proposed max_abs, a min or mean check, and an analytic clipped-RMS check. Implemented instead: max and min of limited.dat (tooling T4), each within 1 % of +-0.783986. A Rail outputs exactly its limits, and about 1600 samples clip at each end, so the extremes equal the clip levels on every seed (verified on 100 seeds). The noise standard deviation is measured directly as the RMS of a second observation point, noise_in.dat, within 2 %. This is stronger than inferring it from the clipped RMS. Measured spread over 100 seeds: -0.88..+0.54 %. (2) The plan's 'clip levels computed for sigma 0.5' is the single-edit mutant hi 0.98; the symmetric version is probe symmetric_old_sigma. (3) The instruction ties each clip level to standard deviation exactly 0.4 (see C4 below).
